loadFailed: Could not load the school. Please refresh the page.
suspended: Your school's Tutre account is suspended. Contact Tutre to reactivate it.
notAdmin: You are not a school admin. School admins manage members, sections and invite codes here.

members.adminNote: The head admin adds and removes school admins and can hand the head role to another admin. Any school admin can add one, with a school admin code or by making a teacher an admin.
members.nobody: Nobody yet. Create a code on the Invite codes tab.
members.removeMessage: {{name}} ({{role}}) will lose access to this school and be taken off all its sections. You can restore them later, but you will need to add them to sections again.
members.head: Head
members.tutreSupportNote: Always has access, so the school is never left without an admin.
members.makeAdminFailed: Could not make them an admin.
members.makeHeadMessage: {{name}} becomes the head admin and can add and remove school admins. You stay a school admin.
members.makeHeadFailed: Could not hand over the head role.
members.removeAdminMessage: {{name}} will no longer be a school admin. If they also teach here, they keep their teacher role.
members.adminRemoved: {{name}} is no longer a school admin.

sections.name: Name
sections.archivedNote: Archived sections are no longer shown to their teachers and students; their member lists are kept. Their codes, including the class code, stop working while the section is archived, and work again if you unarchive it.

codes.createNote: A section code also puts the person in that section. Staff join with their code in this portal; students join in the student app.
codes.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.
codes.revoked: Code {{code}} revoked. It can no longer be used.

teaching.loadFailed: Could not load your sections. Please refresh the page.
teaching.suspended: Your school's Tutre account is suspended. Contact your school admin.
teaching.none: You don't teach any sections yet. Your school admin assigns teachers to sections.
teaching.noStudents: No students yet. Share the class code, or print slips from the class list; you approve each student who asks to join.
teaching.removeConfirmMessage: {{name}} will be taken off {{section}}. They stay in the school, and can rejoin with a section code.
teaching.noCodes: No student codes for this section yet.
teaching.otherCodesNote: One-off codes with your own limits, for example for a single new student.

join.title: Join your school
join.message: Enter the code your school or Tutre gave you. It has 10 letters and numbers, like ABCDE-23456.
join.notStaffYet: This account is not on a school's staff yet. Ask your school admin for a staff code.
join.studentCode: This is a student code. Students join in the Tutre student app.
join.invalid: This code is not valid. Ask your school for a new one.
join.failed: Could not join. Please try again.
join.suspended: Your school's Tutre account is suspended. Contact Tutre to reactivate it.

classCode.title: Class code
classCode.note: Students enter this code, or open the link, to ask to join this section. You approve each request under Waiting for approval.
classCode.replaceMessage: The current code for {{section}} stops working at once. Students already in the section stay, and requests already made are not affected.
classCode.failed: Could not load the class code.

notVerified: Tutre has not verified this school yet, so students cannot ask to join. Teachers can already join and prepare. Contact Tutre to have the school verified.

requests.none: Nobody is waiting. Students ask to join with the class code or their slip.
requests.approveMatched: Approve all on the class list ({{count}})

classList.title: Class list ({{joined}} of {{count}} joined)
classList.note: The students you expect, as on your register. Requests with a matching roll number are marked, and each student can get a personal slip code.
classList.name: Full name
classList.pasteLabel: Class list, one student per line
classList.pasteHelp: One student per line: roll number, then a comma (or tab), then the full name.
classList.addFailed: Could not add them. Is a roll number already on the list?
classList.pasteRejected_one: One line is not "roll number, name": {{line}}
classList.pasteRejected_other: {{count}} lines are not "roll number, name", for example: {{line}}
classList.slipFailed: Could not make the slip code.

slips.title: Slips for {{section}}
slips.note: One slip per student who has not joined yet. Each code works once, for that student, until the date shown. Print, cut out and hand them out.
slips.none: Everyone on the class list has joined.
slips.howTo: Open the Tutre student app, choose Join a class and enter this code. Valid until {{date}}.

reset.title: Reset code for {{name}}
reset.instructions: Give this code to them in person. On the sign-in page they choose "Forgot your password?", then enter their email, this code and a new password. It works once, until {{time}}.
reset.once: Shown only now. Making another code cancels this one.
reset.failed: Could not make a reset code.
